note: Which proof sections a changed path can affect (brief 078; tools/game/proofdelta.ts). The first row whose glob matches a path decides it. run: a list of sections, or "full" (the whole proof), or "none" (the player cannot read it; such a path is not even hashed). A path no row matches runs the whole proof: that is the fail-safe, so add a row only with its reason. proofdelta.test.ts holds the HUD, host and proof rows to the sources: a section that reads a HudToolkit or host member, or calls another proof's helper, must be on that file's row (setup below is the exception, with its reason; `bun tools/game/proofdelta.ts host-reads` prints the table). steps: the batch's gated steps the path can affect; absent, a full row forces them all and a list row none. shots: the rows of shots.json the path can show in (none: the shots and budget steps skip it). seconds: each section's share of the 0.2.146 proof, for the estimate only (frame-time spots are out of the proof, `--spots`; r118 was thinned from 185 s).

setup.why: host calls every proof makes to reach its moment (start a run, pause, step the clock, select, give an order, find a view, close a ring, turn the view). They run in whichever section runs, so a break in them shows there; hostGaps does not count them, or every section would sit on the host's core row.

rows.why: the mission's words: host content, no engine input. The words step checks them (schema, text.test.ts, tools/game/proofwords.json holds what the proofs compare) and copies them; the HUD shots and the sections whose checks read the pill's words see them
the whole file: its fields have different readers, so proofdelta.ts snapshots them apart and the four rows below place each; the file's own line decides nothing
the file's prose: nothing reads it
view only: tools/sim/unity.ts copies it to StreamingAssets/sim/handover.listen-partners.json, placed by its own row below, which runs the sections that read it. No engine, world or scene reads it

the named points: Proof067 reads them at shot time, the briefing and its stills from the build's copy (FrontEndBuild, HostBriefing). The engine has them only through sim/data's site, written by hand with sim:site and on the full row; no world or scene step reads them

destinations and crew: the street generator keeps clear of them (tools/world/civic/handover.ts), so the world step runs and a moved export goes full by its own row. clock.startsAt and the door's yaw: PlayInstall, the scene step. Roles, windows, timeline: the briefing. The engine has the rest only through sim/data, on the full row
